summary: Moomoo行业板块榜因403未完成，Futunn/Moomoo Sparks因超时未完成，首页双排行分别明确降级；公开行情交叉核验显示黄金、白银现金时段下跌但夜盘反转。09:16 CST Futu夜盘QQQ、SPY、DIA代理分别涨0.542%、0.339%、0.331%，NVDA财报后涨4.55%、SMH涨1.919%；工信部十五五路线图与舜宇、理想、中海油、安踏业绩共同影响A/H开盘。 NVDA营收与指引显著超预期后盘前涨约5.8%—7%，OKTA、CRM、CRWD财报后分别涨约17.7%、10.3%、8.9%，纳指期货领涨；油价回落提供缓冲，但10年期美债约4.66%、通胀黏性和Jackson Hole限制无条件追高。今晚关注MRVL、ADSK、WDAY、RBRK与S。

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗与阿曼推进霍尔木兹临时航运走廊
路透与美联社8月26日报道，双方继续讨论联合临时通航走廊和清雷安排；伊朗同时称在美国满足停火条件前不会全面开放海峡。事实是外交窗口仍在，判断上压低油价风险溢价，但协议细节与执行均未确定。
国际
美国扩大对伊朗制裁，能源安全风险仍未解除
美国本周扩大针对伊朗核、导弹、网络与石油网络的制裁，并警告与伊朗保持金融往来的国家；伊朗称将抵制。布油周三结算跌0.84%，但霍尔木兹仍承载全球关键油气流量，制裁升级或航运再受扰可迅速逆转油价。
科技
行业榜与Sparks抓取受限，黄金与科技遗漏风险已交叉核验
Moomoo行业页返回403，行业板块榜未完成；Futunn首选与Moomoo备用Sparks均超时，概念榜未完成，因此没有把代理样本写成完整排行。Futu现金时段显示GLD -1.58%、SLV -1.17%、COPX -0.81%、SMH近持平；夜盘分别转为+0.564%、+1.201%、+0.198%、+1.919%，黄金、贵金属与半导体的反转风险已单独核验。
科技
英伟达收入与利润大幅超预期，AI硬件夜盘共振
英伟达FY2027二季度收入962.2亿美元、同比增106%，高于FactSet一致预期922.7亿美元；调整后EPS 2.22美元，高于2.09美元，数据中心收入890亿美元、同比增117%。09:16 CST夜盘NVDA +4.55%、SMH +1.919%、MU +2.546%、MRVL +3.218%，映射A/H光模块、服务器、PCB、先进封装与存储。
科技
软件与网络安全延续强势，AI交易从硬件向应用扩散
现金时段IGV上涨0.53%、HACK上涨1.41%，夜盘IGV进一步上涨2.383%；ORCL夜盘+1.088%，但PLTR -0.456%形成分化。A/H软件与云服务需以开盘相对恒生科技和创业板的强弱确认，不把美股ETF代理等同完整行业广度。
科技
工信部十五五路线图聚焦集成电路、算力网络与机器人
国新办8月26日发布会提出培育集成电路、航空航天、生物医药、低空经济、新型储能和智能机器人等支柱产业，加快下一代通信与算力网络建设，并推进6G、具身智能等未来产业。政策为国产算力与机器人提供中期催化，短线仍需成交和订单验证。
财报
舜宇光学营收与EPS均高于预期
Futu日历显示舜宇光学2026Q2收入219.06亿元，高于预期204.28亿元约7.2%；EPS 1.6766元，高于预期1.52元约10.3%，EBIT亦高于预期。09:15 CST盘前指示价64.30港元、较前收62.60港元高约2.7%，但尚无成交，需开盘量价确认。
财报
理想汽车收入略超预期但亏损显著扩大
Futu日历显示理想汽车2026Q2收入256.67亿元，高于预期250.69亿元约2.4%；EPS -0.85元，明显差于预期-0.05元，EBIT亏损23.01亿元亦弱于预期。盘前指示价49.50港元较前收高约2.9%但无成交，利好价格反馈尚未确认，列为风险观察而非追多。
财报
中海油EPS低于预期，油价回落增加业绩后压力
Futu日历显示中海油2026Q2 EPS 0.99元，低于预期1.12元约11.6%，EBIT亦低于预期；公司公告称上半年产量与利润创同期新高。09:15 CST盘前指示价24.84港元、较前收24.92港元略低且无成交，叠加布油回落，能源链需等待承接。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
三只高流动性ETF代理同步转强
Futu OpenD于09:16 CST显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）+0.542%、SPY（标普500代理）+0.339%、DIA（道指代理）+0.331%。三者均为有成交的实时夜盘ETF代理，不是指数期货；行情来自8月26日美股收盘后的夜盘字段，抓取时间与更新时间相差2分钟。
板块对照
完整panel不可得，代理交叉核验显示多处潜在反转
行业榜与Sparks均未取得排行行，故无法对panel Top5/Bottom5代表股逐项判定“确认、背离或潜在反转”，也不默认现金方向延续。公开代理交叉核验：SMH现金近持平、夜盘+1.919%为向上确认；IGV现金+0.53%、夜盘+2.383%为确认；GLD现金-1.58%、夜盘+0.564%，SLV现金-1.17%、夜盘+1.201%，均为潜在反转；XLE现金+0.60%、夜盘+0.144%为弱确认。
A/H映射
AI硬件获增量利多，金银与油气需等待开盘确认
NVDA、SMH、MU与MRVL夜盘共振，为A/H光模块、服务器、PCB、先进封装和存储带来正向增量；黄金与白银由现金下跌转为夜盘上涨，资源股可能修复但不宜把反转当作已确认。若恒生科技与创业板竞价不跟随QQQ、芯片成交不放大，或GLD/SLV夜盘涨幅消失，则映射失效。

盘前结论

事实：英伟达收入和EPS超预期，QQQ、SPY、DIA及半导体、存储夜盘代理同步上涨，AI硬件获得直接价格确认。完整行业榜与Sparks概念榜均未取得，市场广度与主题排序存在信息缺口。

判断：A/H开盘优先观察光模块、服务器、PCB、先进封装与国产算力的量价承接，舜宇与安踏有本地业绩支撑。黄金、白银虽出现夜盘反转，但现金时段仍弱；理想汽车收入超预期却亏损扩大，均采用“先验证、后跟随”。

不确定性：霍尔木兹谈判、美国对伊朗制裁、长端利率和港股盘前无成交指示价都可能改变开盘反馈；若AI链高开低走或恒生科技弱于大盘，应降低追涨。

重点个股推荐

中际旭创
300308
AI映射

推荐理由：NVDA、SMH与MRVL夜盘共振，海外AI资本开支对高速光模块需求形成直接映射。

触发因素：集合竞价强于创业板，开盘后成交放大并保持相对CPO板块领先。

风险点：高预期与高估值放大兑现压力；若NVDA夜盘涨幅回落或高开低走，不追涨。

中芯国际
00981
国产算力

推荐理由：SMH夜盘上涨1.919%，工信部同时强调集成电路、算力网络与新型工业化，内外催化共振。

触发因素：开盘强于恒生科技与半导体同业，南向成交扩张且能守住首小时均价。

风险点：海外AI需求并不等同本土晶圆订单；政策预期若无成交承接，可能高开低走。

舜宇光学科技
02382
业绩验证

推荐理由：Q2收入、EPS与EBIT均高于预期，消费电子与汽车光学有本地财报支撑。

触发因素：正式开盘高于前收并出现成交放大，且手机设备及恒生科技不明显走弱。

风险点：盘前指示价无成交；毛利率、订单与管理层指引若不及高预期，正反馈会失效。

理想汽车-W
02015
仅观察

推荐理由：收入略超预期且美股LI夜盘上涨0.494%，但亏损显著差于预期，不构成追多条件。

触发因素：仅在正式开盘放量守住前收、并强于港股汽车板块时升级为交易观察。

风险点：EPS与EBIT大幅低于预期，盘前无成交指示价可能失真；若低开则继续回避。

板块轮动看板

受益方向光模块、服务器、PCB、先进封装、存储与国产算力；NVDA、SMH、MU、MRVL夜盘共同上涨。
观察方向软件应用、网络安全、智能机器人、消费电子；政策与美股价格均有催化，但A/H广度需开盘确认。
压力方向油气与高亏损新能源车；油价夜盘偏弱，中海油EPS低于预期，理想汽车亏损扩大。
验证信号恒生科技与创业板是否跟随QQQ、芯片与CPO成交是否放大、GLD/SLV反转能否维持、港股业绩股正式开盘价。

逻辑链

英伟达收入、EPS与数据中心业务超预期，夜盘NVDA、SMH、MU与MRVL同步上涨。
海外AI资本开支信号映射至A/H光模块、服务器、PCB、先进封装、存储与国产算力。
工信部十五五路线图强化集成电路、算力网络与机器人政策预期，提供本地催化。
最终交易信号取决于集合竞价相对强弱和成交放大；行业榜缺失、利率或高开低走是主要失效风险。

风险雷达

完整板块榜缺口

Moomoo行业榜与Sparks均未完成，代理核验不能代表完整市场广度和排序。

AI高预期兑现

英伟达财报强劲已带来夜盘上涨，A/H高开后若量价不跟随，容易转为获利了结。

霍尔木兹与制裁反复

临时走廊尚未落地，美国制裁或新一轮航运扰动可令油价和通胀预期急升。

利率与美元再定价

若长端美债收益率或美元在亚洲时段反弹，高估值科技对强财报的正反馈可能被压缩。

业绩价格反馈失真

港股盘前指示价多无成交，舜宇、理想、中海油与安踏必须以正式开盘成交验证。

数据来源与时间点

来源：NVIDIA Newsroom FY2027 Q2官方业绩；国新办/新华社8月26日新型工业化发布会；AP、Reuters（伊朗、阿曼、美国制裁、霍尔木兹与油价）；Futu OpenD三市场财报日历、NOTICE检索及股票快照。Moomoo行业页于本次抓取返回403，行业板块榜未完成；Futunn首选与Moomoo备用Sparks超时，概念榜未完成。美股现金/夜盘行情时间为2026-08-26美东盘后，抓取时间2026-08-27 09:16 CST；页面更新时间2026-08-27 09:18 CST。ETF均明确为代理。
entries.html_en:
Major News Roundup
Global
Iran and Oman Advance a Temporary Hormuz Shipping Corridor
Reuters and AP reported on Aug. 26 that the two sides kept discussing a joint temporary navigation corridor and mine clearing; Iran also said the strait would not fully reopen until the United States met ceasefire conditions. The diplomatic window is a fact and may reduce the oil risk premium, but details and implementation remain uncertain.
Global
Expanded US Sanctions Leave Energy-Security Risk Unresolved
Washington expanded sanctions this week against Iranian nuclear, missile, cyber and oil networks and warned countries maintaining financial ties; Iran vowed resistance. Brent settled 0.84% lower Wednesday, but Hormuz remains critical to global oil and gas flows, so tighter sanctions or renewed shipping disruption could quickly reverse crude.
Tech
Ranking Feeds Were Restricted; Gold and Tech Omission Risks Were Cross-Checked
The Moomoo industry page returned 403, so the industry ranking was not completed; both the preferred Futunn and backup Moomoo Sparks pages timed out, so the concept ranking was not completed. Proxy samples are not presented as full rankings. Futu cash data showed GLD -1.58%, SLV -1.17%, COPX -0.81% and SMH nearly flat; overnight they turned to +0.564%, +1.201%, +0.198% and +1.919%, separately checking reversal risk in gold, precious metals and semiconductors.
Tech
Nvidia Beats Revenue and Earnings as AI Hardware Rallies Overnight
Nvidia reported FY2027 Q2 revenue of $96.22 billion, up 106% year over year and above the $92.27 billion FactSet consensus; adjusted EPS of $2.22 beat $2.09, while Data Center revenue reached $89.0 billion, up 117%. At 09:16 CST, NVDA was +4.55% overnight, SMH +1.919%, MU +2.546% and MRVL +3.218%, mapping to A/H optical modules, servers, PCBs, advanced packaging and memory.
Tech
Software and Cybersecurity Stay Firm as AI Broadens Toward Applications
IGV gained 0.53% and HACK 1.41% in the cash session, while IGV extended to +2.383% overnight; ORCL was +1.088%, but PLTR -0.456% showed dispersion. A/H software and cloud names require opening relative strength versus the Hang Seng Tech Index and ChiNext; US ETF proxies are not treated as complete industry breadth.
Tech
MIIT Roadmap Targets Chips, Compute Networks and Robotics
At the Aug. 26 State Council Information Office briefing, officials named integrated circuits, aerospace, biomedicine, the low-altitude economy, new energy storage and intelligent robotics as emerging pillars, while calling for next-generation communications and compute networks plus 6G and embodied intelligence. The roadmap is a medium-term catalyst, but near-term orders and turnover still need verification.
Earnings
Sunny Optical Beats Revenue and EPS Expectations
The Futu calendar showed 2026 Q2 revenue of RMB21.906 billion, about 7.2% above the RMB20.428 billion estimate; EPS of RMB1.6766 beat RMB1.52 by about 10.3%, and EBIT also topped expectations. The 09:15 CST indicative price was HK$64.30 versus a HK$62.60 close, about +2.7%, but with no turnover; the official open must confirm the signal.
Earnings
Li Auto Revenue Edges Above Forecast as Losses Widen Sharply
The Futu calendar showed 2026 Q2 revenue of RMB25.667 billion, about 2.4% above the RMB25.069 billion estimate; EPS of -RMB0.85 was far worse than -RMB0.05, and the RMB2.301 billion EBIT loss also missed. The HK$49.50 indicative price was about 2.9% above the prior close but had no turnover, so positive price feedback is unconfirmed and the name remains a risk watch, not a chase.
Earnings
CNOOC EPS Misses as Lower Oil Adds Post-Result Pressure
The Futu calendar showed 2026 Q2 EPS of RMB0.99, about 11.6% below the RMB1.12 estimate, with EBIT also below forecast; the company said first-half output and profit reached record levels for the period. At 09:15 CST the HK$24.84 indicative price was slightly below the HK$24.92 close and had no turnover; lower Brent leaves energy awaiting support.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Three Liquid ETF Proxies Turn Higher Together
Futu OpenD at 09:16 CST showed QQQ, the Nasdaq-100 proxy, +0.542%; SPY, the S&P 500 proxy, +0.339%; and DIA, the Dow proxy, +0.331%. All three had real-time overnight trades and are ETF proxies, not index futures; values came from the post-close overnight fields for Aug. 26, with the fetch two minutes before the page update.
Sector Check
Full Panels Were Unavailable; Proxy Cross-Checks Show Several Potential Reversals
Neither the industry nor Sparks feed yielded ranking rows, so Top5/Bottom5 representative stocks could not be classified row by row as confirmation, divergence or potential reversal, and cash-session direction is not assumed to persist. Public proxy checks showed SMH nearly flat in cash and +1.919% overnight as upside confirmation; IGV +0.53% in cash and +2.383% overnight as confirmation; GLD -1.58% then +0.564% and SLV -1.17% then +1.201% as potential reversals; XLE +0.60% then +0.144% as weak confirmation.
A/H Mapping
AI Hardware Gains Incremental Support; Gold, Silver and Energy Need Validation
Overnight alignment in NVDA, SMH, MU and MRVL adds support for A/H optical modules, servers, PCBs, advanced packaging and memory; gold and silver turned positive after cash-session declines, so resources may rebound, but reversal is not yet confirmation. The mapping fails if Hang Seng Tech and ChiNext do not follow QQQ, chip turnover does not expand, or GLD and SLV lose their overnight gains.

Pre-Market Conclusion

Fact: Nvidia beat revenue and EPS expectations, while QQQ, SPY, DIA and semiconductor and memory proxies rose together overnight, providing direct price confirmation for AI hardware.The complete industry and Sparks concept rankings were unavailable, leaving a gap in breadth and theme ordering.

View: Watch opening support in optical modules, servers, PCBs, advanced packaging and domestic compute first; Sunny Optical and Anta also have local earnings support.Gold and silver reversed overnight after cash-session weakness, while Li Auto beat revenue but posted a much wider loss; both require validation before following.

Uncertainty: Hormuz talks, US sanctions on Iran, long yields and no-turnover Hong Kong indicative prices can all change the open; reduce chasing if the AI chain opens high and fades or Hang Seng Tech lags.

Stock Focus

Trigger: Outperform ChiNext in the opening auction, expand turnover after the open and retain leadership within CPO.

Risk: High expectations and valuation amplify profit-taking; do not chase if NVDA loses its overnight gain or the stock opens high and fades.

Risk: Overseas AI demand does not automatically become domestic foundry orders; policy expectations without turnover can produce a fade.

Risk: The indicative price had no turnover; margins, orders or management guidance below elevated expectations would invalidate positive feedback.

Risk: EPS and EBIT missed badly, and a no-turnover indicative price may mislead; continue avoiding if the official open is lower.

Sector Rotation Board

Pressure AreasOil and gas plus loss-making EVs; crude softened overnight, CNOOC EPS missed and Li Auto losses widened.
ValidationWhether Hang Seng Tech and ChiNext follow QQQ, chip and CPO turnover expands, GLD/SLV reversals persist, and earnings names confirm official opening prices.

Logic Chain

Nvidia beat revenue, EPS and Data Center expectations, lifting NVDA, SMH, MU and MRVL together overnight.
The global AI-capex signal maps into A/H optical modules, servers, PCBs, advanced packaging, memory and domestic compute.
MIIT's five-year roadmap reinforces policy expectations for integrated circuits, compute networks and robotics.
The trading signal still depends on auction relative strength and expanding turnover; missing full rankings, yields or opening fades are the main invalidation risks.

Risk Radar

Full Ranking Gap

The Moomoo industry ranking and Sparks scan were incomplete; proxy checks cannot represent full breadth or ordering.

AI Expectations Priced In

Strong Nvidia results already lifted overnight prices; an A/H opening without volume can turn into profit-taking.

Hormuz and Sanctions Volatility

The temporary corridor is not implemented; tighter US sanctions or renewed shipping disruption could lift crude and inflation expectations sharply.

Rates and Dollar Repricing

A rebound in long Treasury yields or the dollar during Asia hours could compress the positive response of high-valuation tech to strong earnings.

Misleading Indicative Prices

Many Hong Kong pre-open indications had no turnover; Sunny, Li Auto, CNOOC and Anta require official-open volume confirmation.

Sources and Timing

Sources: NVIDIA Newsroom official FY2027 Q2 results; State Council Information Office/Xinhua Aug. 26 new-industrialization briefing; AP and Reuters on Iran, Oman, US sanctions, Hormuz and crude; Futu OpenD earnings calendars for three markets, NOTICE searches and stock snapshots. The Moomoo industry page returned 403 in this run, so the industry ranking was not completed; the preferred Futunn and backup Moomoo Sparks pages timed out, so the concept ranking was not completed. entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
财报
NVIDIA营收、盈利与指引全面超预期
NVDA FY2027二季度营收962.2亿美元、调整后EPS 2.22美元，均高于约922.7亿美元和2.09美元的一致预期；三季度收入指引约1080亿美元，也高于约1040亿美元预期，且未计入中国数据中心算力收入。
价格
NVDA盘前涨约5.8%—7%，AI链获得真实正反馈
07:52 ET附近NVDA约涨5.8%，更早一度超过7%；纳指100期货早段约涨1%，明显强于标普500期货约0.4%。价格确认支持AI链高开，但日内仍需防范财报后获利回吐。
软件
OKTA、CRM与CRWD财报后集体跳涨
盘前快照显示OKTA约涨17.7%、CRM约涨10.3%、CRWD约涨8.9%。身份安全、企业软件与网络安全同时获得价格正反馈，说明AI变现与安全需求不只集中在芯片。
芯片
存储与互连受NVDA外溢带动
MU、SNDK、AMD与AVGO盘前走高，市场把NVDA的需求强度映射到内存、存储、定制芯片与互连。MRVL约涨2%，但今晚财报让其更适合作为事件观察而非无条件追涨。
零售
DG与DLTR盈利和指引均好于预期
Dollar General与Dollar Tree二季度业绩超过华尔街预期并上调全年利润展望，DG盘前约涨10.9%；消费降级与价值零售韧性为科技以外提供轮动支点。
宏观
PCE偏黏与10年期约4.66%仍压制估值
昨日公布的核心PCE同比3.3%，通胀仍高于目标；今早10年期美债收益率约4.66%。强盈利暂时压过利率压力，但长端若重新上行，高估值软件与半导体将先受冲击。
能源
油价延续回落，通胀风险溢价暂缓
布伦特约88.43美元、WTI约82.54美元，围绕霍尔木兹通行的谈判缓和供应担忧。能源回落利好长久期资产，但中东局势反复仍可能快速逆转。
政策
Jackson Hole开幕，市场等待Warsh周五讲话
全球央行年会今天开始，市场关注美联储主席Kevin Warsh周五对通胀、长端利率和政策路径的表态；这使科技财报利好之外仍存在利率事件风险。
数据
初请与库存数据处于8:30 ET发布窗口
本周初请一致预期约20.8万、前值20.6万；截至本稿截点，官方当期页面尚未完成索引，因此不把预估写成实际。开盘前数据与债市反应需要继续核对。
今晚
MRVL、ADSK、WDAY、RBRK与S盘后披露
今晚科技财报密集，覆盖AI互连、设计软件、人力财务软件、数据安全和端点安全。NVDA、CRM与网络安全的强反馈抬高了同业门槛，指引质量比小幅EPS beat更重要。

盘前结论

事实：NVDA、OKTA、CRM与CRWD财报后盘前分别获得约5.8%—7%、17.7%、10.3%与8.9%的正反馈，纳指100期货约涨1%。盈利驱动而非单纯叙事，支持科技偏强开盘。

判断：基准情景是AI芯片、网络安全与企业软件领涨，并向存储和互连扩散。但10年期约4.66%、核心PCE 3.3%，利率仍会筛掉高估值弱势股。

不确定性：盘前量能明细不完整，且Jackson Hole与今晚MRVL等财报抬高事件风险；若NVDA或软件三强高开低走、收益率上行，应降低仓位而非追逐headline。

NVDA财报软件三击AI需求利率闸门Jackson Hole安全需求油价回落价值零售MRVL财报通胀黏性初请待核量价确认

重点个股推荐

NVIDIA
NVDA
财报强势

推荐理由：盘前约涨5.8%—7%，显著强于大盘；962.2亿美元营收、2.22美元调整后EPS与1080亿美元下季收入指引均获得正价格反馈。公开盘前量能明细不完整。

触发因素：开盘守住盘前缺口并继续强于QQQ、SMH，且成交扩张。

风险点：高预期、内存成本与毛利率压力；若高开低走跌回昨收附近，停止追多。

Okta
OKTA
身份安全领涨

推荐理由：财报后盘前约涨17.7%，为软件样本中最强价格反馈之一；订阅积压增长与AI身份需求得到市场认可。公开盘前量能明细不完整。

触发因素：开盘回踩不填满缺口，且相对CRWD与软件指数保持强势并放量。

风险点：跳空过大易获利回吐；若前30分钟失守盘前支撑，降级为观察。

Salesforce
CRM
企业软件反转

推荐理由：盘前约涨10.3%，财报与上调展望扭转此前弱势，且与CRWD、OKTA形成软件共振。公开盘前量能明细不完整。

触发因素：开盘站稳盘前中枢，剩余履约义务与Agentforce叙事继续获得机构承接。

风险点：估值修复依赖持续变现；若涨幅快速缩至低个位数，避免追高。

CrowdStrike
CRWD
安全景气

推荐理由：盘前约涨8.9%，EPS beat并上调展望，ARR与网络安全需求给予正反馈，明显强于QQQ。公开盘前量能明细不完整。

触发因素：开盘继续强于OKTA以外的安全同业并出现成交扩张。

风险点：高估值与大缺口；若开盘卖压吞没一半盘前涨幅，先锁定利润。

板块轮动看板

强势观察AI芯片与网络安全：NVDA、AMD、MU、SNDK、OKTA、CRM、CRWD；只跟随开盘后仍强于QQQ且成交扩张者。
事件驱动今晚MRVL、ADSK、WDAY、RBRK、S财报；Jackson Hole开幕，周五Warsh讲话。
压力方向HPQ财报后约跌10%，以及10年期收益率再上行时的高估值长久期软件；不因行业利好忽视负价格反馈。
验证信号纳指期货优势能否延续；NVDA能否守住缺口；OKTA/CRM/CRWD是否放量；10年期与油价是否反弹。

逻辑链

NVDA同时超过营收、EPS和下一季收入预期，先确认AI基础设施需求仍强。
NVDA、OKTA、CRM与CRWD盘前大涨，价格反馈把利好从芯片扩散到企业软件与安全。
油价回落提供通胀缓冲，但核心PCE 3.3%和10年期约4.66%意味着估值上限仍在。
因此基准情景是纳指高开、AI与安全领涨但日内分化；开盘成交、收益率和缺口保持度决定追随。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为基于已知一致预期、历史 surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气的主观判断，并非确定事实。已核对Kiplinger/Briefing.com、Digrin、Yahoo Finance日历、公司IR、TipRanks、Zacks与公开业绩记录；具体公司均计划于8月27日美股盘后披露。

高概率 · Marvell Technology (MRVL) · 68%一致预期约EPS 0.93美元、营收27.1—27.2亿美元；UBS将估值上修至0.94美元/27.6亿美元，Stifel也预期营收beat，AI互连和定制芯片景气获NVDA验证。风险是年内涨幅约180%、Q3指引门槛高。
中高概率 · Rubrik (RBRK) · 63%一致预期约EPS 0.04美元、营收4.04亿美元；上一季EPS 0.16美元显著高于-0.03美元预期，数据与身份韧性需求延续。风险是GAAP亏损、上次beat后股价仍下跌，指引与估值反应可能背离。
中概率 · Autodesk (ADSK) · 60%一致预期约EPS 3.12—3.18美元、营收约21亿美元；订阅模式和成本纪律支持小幅超预期。风险是设计活动、账单增速和全年指引，卖方修正证据不如MRVL清晰。
中概率 · SentinelOne (S) · 55%一致预期约EPS 0.07美元、营收2.90—2.96亿美元；CRWD与OKTA的强财报验证安全需求，但S规模较小、竞争更强，经营杠杆和下一季指引决定能否beat。
低概率 · Workday (WDAY) · 47%一致预期约EPS 2.61—2.66美元、营收约27亿美元；订阅韧性提供底盘，但最新精确估值低于一致预期，显示卖方修正偏谨慎，且AI产品变现与大单时点存在不确定性。

风险雷达

财报后高开回落

NVDA及软件大缺口若在开盘后快速收窄，说明隔夜利好已被兑现，不能继续追多。

长端收益率再上行

核心PCE仍为3.3%，10年期若突破早段水平将压缩高估值科技承接。

Jackson Hole政策意外

Warsh若强化加息或长期高利率立场，美元与收益率可能同步上行。

中东与油价反转

霍尔木兹谈判缓和并非终局，供应扰动可让油价与通胀预期突然反弹。

盘前量能缺口

公开源未提供全部候选股可比盘前成交，所有推荐均要求开盘量价确认。

数据来源与时间点

来源：NVIDIA业绩稿与电话会摘要；AP、Reuters、Axios、Yahoo Finance、TipRanks（期指、盘前个股、油价、收益率、Jackson Hole）；Market Extended Hours盘前快照；Kiplinger/Briefing.com、Digrin、Yahoo Finance、公司IR、TipRanks与Zacks财报日历/预期。抓取/更新时间：2026-08-27 20:35 CST（约08:35 ET）。盘前量能明细与当期初请官方索引不完整，已按规则降级并要求开盘确认。
entries.html_en:
Major News Roundup
Earnings
NVIDIA beat broadly on revenue, profit and guidance
NVDA reported fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.22 billion and adjusted EPS of $2.22, above consensus near $92.27 billion and $2.09. Its roughly $108 billion Q3 revenue outlook also topped expectations near $104 billion and excludes China data-center compute revenue.
Price
NVDA gains about 5.8%–7% premarket, validating the AI read-through
NVDA was up about 5.8% near 07:52 ET and had earlier exceeded 7%. Nasdaq 100 futures rose about 1% early, clearly ahead of roughly 0.4% for S&P 500 futures. The price response supports an AI-led open, though post-earnings profit-taking remains a session risk.
Software
OKTA, CRM and CRWD jump together after earnings
Premarket snapshots showed OKTA up about 17.7%, CRM 10.3% and CRWD 8.9%. Identity, enterprise software and cybersecurity all received positive price feedback, showing that AI monetization and security demand extend beyond chips.
Chips
Memory and interconnect names gain on the NVDA read-through
MU, SNDK, AMD and AVGO rose premarket as traders mapped NVIDIA demand into memory, storage, custom silicon and interconnects. MRVL gained about 2%, but tonight’s earnings make it an event watch rather than an unconditional chase.
Retail
DG and DLTR beat and raise
Dollar General and Dollar Tree topped Wall Street’s second-quarter expectations and raised full-year profit outlooks, with DG up about 10.9% premarket. Trade-down demand and value-retail resilience offer a rotation anchor outside technology.
Macro
Sticky PCE and a roughly 4.66% 10-year yield still cap valuation
Core PCE published yesterday was 3.3% year over year, still above target, while the 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.66% this morning. Earnings strength currently dominates, but a renewed yield rise would hit expensive software and semiconductors first.
Energy
Oil extends its decline, easing the inflation premium for now
Brent traded near $88.43 and WTI near $82.54 as talks around Strait of Hormuz transit eased supply fears. Lower energy supports long-duration assets, but another Middle East escalation could reverse the move quickly.
Policy
Jackson Hole begins; markets await Warsh on Friday
The global central-bank symposium starts today, with investors focused on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Friday comments on inflation, long yields and the policy path. That leaves a rate-event risk beyond the tech earnings boost.
Data
Claims and inventory data sit in the 8:30 ET release window
Consensus for weekly initial claims was about 208,000 versus 206,000 previously. The current official release had not finished indexing by this brief’s cutoff, so the forecast is not presented as an actual. The data and bond reaction still require confirmation before the open.
Tonight
MRVL, ADSK, WDAY, RBRK and S report after the close
Tonight’s technology slate spans AI interconnects, design software, HR and finance software, data security and endpoint security. Strong reactions to NVDA, CRM and cybersecurity raise the hurdle for peers, making guidance quality more important than a small EPS beat.

Premarket Conclusion

Fact: NVDA, OKTA, CRM and CRWD received positive post-earnings premarket reactions of roughly 5.8%–7%, 17.7%, 10.3% and 8.9%, while Nasdaq 100 futures gained about 1%.Earnings rather than narrative support a tech-led open.

View: AI chips, cybersecurity and enterprise software should lead, with spillover into memory and interconnects.But a roughly 4.66% 10-year yield and 3.3% core PCE will still filter out expensive laggards.

Uncertainty: detailed premarket volume is incomplete, while Jackson Hole and tonight’s MRVL-led slate raise event risk. Reduce exposure rather than chase headlines if NVDA or the software trio fade their gaps as yields rise.

Keyword Cloud

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 show heat/importance, not percentage moves.

Stocks to Watch

NVIDIA
NVDA
Earnings strength

Why it stands out: shares gained about 5.8%–7% premarket, far ahead of the market; $96.22 billion revenue, $2.22 adjusted EPS and roughly $108 billion next-quarter revenue guidance all earned positive price feedback. Detailed public premarket volume was incomplete.

Trigger: hold the premarket gap after the open, remain stronger than QQQ and SMH, and expand turnover.

Risk: high expectations, memory costs and margin pressure; stop chasing if a gap fade returns shares near the prior close.

Okta
OKTA
Identity leader

Why it stands out: shares rose about 17.7% premarket, among the strongest software reactions, as subscription backlog growth and AI identity demand gained market approval. Detailed public premarket volume was incomplete.

Trigger: a pullback holds most of the gap while relative strength versus CRWD and the software index persists on volume.

Risk: the large gap invites profit-taking; downgrade to watch if the first 30 minutes lose premarket support.

Salesforce
CRM
Enterprise reversal

Why it stands out: shares rose about 10.3% premarket as the beat and raised outlook reversed prior weakness, with CRWD and OKTA confirming a software-wide response. Detailed public premarket volume was incomplete.

Trigger: hold the premarket midpoint after the open as RPO and Agentforce monetization attract institutional demand.

Risk: the rerating needs sustained monetization; avoid chasing if the gain quickly shrinks to low single digits.

CrowdStrike
CRWD
Security demand

Why it stands out: shares gained about 8.9% premarket after an EPS beat and raised outlook, while ARR and cybersecurity demand produced clear positive feedback versus QQQ. Detailed public premarket volume was incomplete.

Trigger: remain stronger than security peers other than OKTA and show expanding opening turnover.

Risk: premium valuation and a large gap; protect gains if opening supply erases half the premarket advance.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength watchAI chips and cybersecurity: NVDA, AMD, MU, SNDK, OKTA, CRM and CRWD; follow only names that stay ahead of QQQ on expanding turnover.
Event drivenMRVL, ADSK, WDAY, RBRK and S report tonight; Jackson Hole begins, with Warsh speaking Friday.
PressureHPQ fell about 10% after earnings, while expensive long-duration software remains exposed to another 10-year yield rise; negative price feedback overrides sector narratives.
ValidationCan the Nasdaq futures lead persist, can NVDA hold its gap, do OKTA/CRM/CRWD expand volume, and do the 10-year yield or oil rebound?

Logic Chain

NVDA beat revenue, EPS and next-quarter revenue expectations, first confirming that AI infrastructure demand remains strong.
Premarket jumps in NVDA, OKTA, CRM and CRWD spread the positive price signal from chips into enterprise software and security.
Lower oil offers an inflation cushion, but 3.3% core PCE and a roughly 4.66% 10-year yield preserve the valuation ceiling.
The base case is therefore a Nasdaq-led open with AI and security strength but intraday dispersion; turnover, yields and gap retention determine whether to follow.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probabilities

These are subjective judgments based on known consensus, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions and industry conditions—not facts. Calendars and evidence checked include Kiplinger/Briefing.com, Digrin, Yahoo Finance, company IR, TipRanks, Zacks and public earnings records; each named company is scheduled after the U.S. close on August 27.

High · Marvell Technology (MRVL) · 68%Consensus is roughly $0.93 EPS and $2.71–$2.72 billion revenue. UBS raised its estimates to $0.94 and $2.76 billion, Stifel also expects a revenue beat, and NVDA validated AI interconnect and custom-silicon demand. Risks are the roughly 180% year-to-date run and a high Q3 guidance bar.
Medium-high · Rubrik (RBRK) · 63%Consensus is about $0.04 EPS and $404 million revenue. Last quarter’s $0.16 EPS substantially beat a negative $0.03 estimate, while data and identity resilience demand continues. Risks include GAAP losses and the stock falling after the prior beat, so guidance and price response can diverge.
Medium · Autodesk (ADSK) · 60%Consensus is roughly $3.12–$3.18 EPS on about $2.1 billion revenue. Subscription economics and cost discipline support a modest beat. Risks are design activity, billings growth and full-year guidance, with less clear positive revision evidence than MRVL.
Medium · SentinelOne (S) · 55%Consensus is about $0.07 EPS and $290–$296 million revenue. Strong CRWD and OKTA results validate security demand, but SentinelOne is smaller and faces tougher competition; operating leverage and next-quarter guidance determine the beat.
Low · Workday (WDAY) · 47%Consensus is roughly $2.61–$2.66 EPS on about $2.7 billion revenue. Subscription resilience provides a base, but the latest most-accurate estimate sits below consensus, signaling cautious revisions, while AI monetization and large-deal timing remain uncertain.

Risk Radar

Post-earnings gap fade

If large NVDA and software gaps narrow quickly after the open, overnight good news was already monetized and should not be chased.

Long-end yield rebound

Core PCE remains 3.3%; a 10-year break above the early level would reduce support for expensive technology.

Jackson Hole policy surprise

A more hawkish higher-for-longer or rate-hike signal from Warsh could lift the dollar and yields together.

Middle East and oil reversal

Strait of Hormuz talks are not a final settlement; supply disruption could abruptly revive oil and inflation expectations.

Premarket volume gap

Public sources did not provide comparable premarket turnover for every candidate, so all ideas require opening price-volume confirmation.

Sources and Timestamp
